content.text: Denver Criminal Defense Attorneys Delivering the Powerful Defense You Deserve If you are facing criminal charges in Denver, your reputation, career, and freedom are at risk. You need an experienced Denver criminal defense attorney who will fight to protect your rights. At Springer & Steinberg, P.C., we provide aggressive representation and refuse to pressure clients into quick plea deals. Our goal is to build a strong defense and pursue the best possible result in every case. Our criminal defense lawyers in Denver have decades of combined trial experience. We have successfully defended clients in cases involving DUI, drug crimes, domestic violence, theft, sex crimes, white-collar crimes, violent felonies, and federal offenses. No matter the charge, we prepare every case as if it is going to trial. This approach ensures we are ready to challenge the prosecution at every step. We know the Colorado criminal court system, the prosecutors, and the strategies that work. Our law firm is committed to reducing or dismissing charges whenever possible. If necessary, we are prepared to fight for you before a judge and jury. When you choose Springer & Steinberg, P.C., you are choosing a team that refuses to back down. If your future is at stake, put your case in the hands of a skilled Denver criminal defense attorney who will stand by you from start to finish. Contact us today to schedule a confidential consultation and learn how our criminal defense lawyers in Denver can help protect your rights and freedom. Reasons to Hire a Denver Criminal Defense Lawyer Without skilled counsel, there is no guarantee that you’ll be treated fairly and impartially, that you’ll be viewed as innocent until proven guilty, or even that your rights will not be infringed upon. Law enforcement officers, prosecutors, judges, and court personnel are not on your side. The only person on your side – who has the know-how to effectively protect your rights – is your criminal defense attorney. Make sure your choice in legal representation is the right one.When you choose us to be your legal representatives, we can help by: Arguing for your early release on bond if necessary. Collecting and analyzing evidence to use in your defense. Working with expert witnesses to counter the prosecution. Negotiating for lessened charges or sentencing. Fighting the prosecution in court if need be. Managing your case entirely to make the process less stressful. We know you are in a difficult position when you have been accused of or charged with a misdemeanor or felony. It will be our goal as your Denver criminal defense attorneys to act on your behalf whenever possible to make the entire procedure as simple for you as possible while also doing all we can to defend your rights and reputation. Put our experience and reputation in your corner. Call our Denver criminal defense lawyers at (303) 861-2800 for a free review of your case. Experienced Representation with a Reputation for Results Harvey A. Steinberg – Nationally Recognized Criminal Defense Attorney Harvey A. Steinberg, Esq. is a well-known figure in Colorado criminal courtrooms. He has gained national media attention for successfully defending numerous high-profile clients, including professional athletes and other public figures. As a founding partner of Springer & Steinberg, P.C., Harvey leads with professionalism, integrity, and an unwavering commitment to protecting each client’s rights and best interests. Stephen Burstein – Trusted Denver Criminal Defense Lawyer Stephen Burstein, Esq. is known for meticulous preparation, persuasive advocacy, and a strategic approach to criminal defense. Recognized by Super Lawyers, Stephen works tirelessly to challenge the prosecution, safeguard client interests, and deliver outstanding results in even the most complex cases. A Defense Team That Stands Apart Together, Harvey and Stephen bring decades of combined experience, proven trial skills, and an unshakable dedication to defending clients in high-stakes criminal matters. Learn more about our criminal defense services and how we can protect your future. Criminal Defense Cases We Accept Our Denver criminal defense attorneys have experience with cases involving: DUI (driving under the influence) Driving under the influence of marijuana or other drugs Drug possession, sales, trafficking, and other drug crimes Burglary, robbery, and other theft-related crimes Domestic violence, assault, murder, and other violent crimes Underage drinking Hit and run offenses, street racing, and other traffic violations Fraud, embezzlement, and other white collar crimes Committed to your Case In other words, if you have been charged for any serious crime or offense in Colorado, then you can find confidence in that our team has likely handled a case very much like it before. There is nothing that the prosecution or the courtroom can throw at us to catch us off-guard or make us give up on a client. Defend Your Rights Today! No matter the type of charge or allegation hanging over you, the situation calls for the type of dedicated and intelligent criminal defense counsel that you can find from our team at Springer & Steinberg, P.C. Put us on your side and give the opposition a reason to think twice about its strategies. Our reputation precedes us, and it protects you from injustice. Contact our offices at (303) 861-2800 to learn more. We serve clients throughout all of Colorado from our office in Denver.
